declaredIdentity: Tenant + import source reference (the imported owner value and its source record); `ResolutionId` must equal that deterministic tuple; manual resolution uses CommandId.
invariant: An imported named owner is bound to a workforce Person only by exact normalized email match at import, otherwise it stays an unresolved_owner reference until one attributed manual resolution names the Person; a name-only or ambiguous match never binds, and the resolution is immutable once recorded (M0-D04 D04-02).

sources.rationale: The exact-email match and the attributed manual resolution are one write decision with no current owner. Jev new_owner_resolution 0.85.

logicalIdentity.rule: caller-supplied immutable creation identity: an exact retry with the same id and authored intent returns the original result; the same id with changed intent is refused; a different id is a different record

selectedIdentitySummary: Tenant + import source reference (the imported owner value and its source record); `ResolutionId` must equal that deterministic tuple; manual resolution uses CommandId.

productRules.rule: An imported named owner matches a workforce person only by exact normalized email; a name-only or ambiguous match remains an unresolved_owner reference that a person must resolve.
